KeystillTyping studio

About Keystill

Keystill is a browser-based typing studio for people working toward a particular speed. Pick a pace, type an original passage and use your mistakes to choose the next drill. The same scoring rules apply at every target speed.

Inspect the work

The passages, timer and scoring code are available in the public project repository, maintained under the GitHub account itachijutsu55itachijutsu. You can compare the implementation with the worked scoring examples.

Report a problem

For a wrong score, include the duration, practice category, browser and what you expected. For a keyboard or screen-reader problem, describe the control you were using. Reports on GitHub are public; keep personal details out of your report.

View issues or report a correction on GitHub
